composition.deduplication: OSM object type, ID and version

cost: Original road length in integer centimetres; shortest distance, not estimated travel time.
limitations: Turn restrictions, barriers and conditional access are retained as source evidence but are not applied.
Ferries and non-motor-road classes are excluded. Experimental desktop feasibility study.
coverage: Nine complete country extracts: Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela; Brazil, Guyana and Suriname excluded. No clipping, tracks or ferry edges.
